evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address these challenges, we introduce SkillCT, a benchmark that broadens skill assessment from downstream utility to a multidimensional characterization of skill quality.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agent skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for specialized tasks and are increasingly distributed through public Web repositories.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Building on this benchmark, we propose an execution-free quality evaluation baseline that predicts the multidimensional quality profiles of unseen skills by retrieving and leveraging similar reference skills, without executing the skills under evaluation.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: However, existing skill benchmarks primarily focus on downstream task execution, insufficiently assessing specification quality, behavioral robustness, semantic alignment, and responsibility boundaries.
